metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds twenty-four lines still, the carrier, the cough gone, and the wedge out from under the stool.

yesterday: Kemp's tally is still twenty-four lines.
The Sunday letter has gone with Hobbins. Twopence. Anne will believe the horse when she hears it. The cough is gone.
A line in another ink mentions a reckoning at the whittawer's, fourteen and six.
The stool is level. The wedge is three leaves of the comedy, cut in January. Mistress Ansell paid the joiner threepence. You kept the paper.
